description.text: Generations Start Decks: nine ready-built 60-card decks, each themed on a region from the Pokémon games and holding two holo Pokémon ex, sold at random one to a box with damage counters and markers. Every deck has two Professor's Research, each deck's in a different professor's art, and a Black Belt's Training in its own art. This set holds the cards of all nine.
